query: We have 4 strategic objectives for our branch. Help us define the required business capabilities and avoid turning them into a software shopping list.
expected_behavior: Defines solution-agnostic business capabilities (what the organization must be able to do) linked to each strategic objective
Reframes any tool-specific suggestions into enduring capabilities
Evaluates current vs. target maturity (0-5) across People, Process, Information, Technology, and Governance

query: Assess our capability gaps for 'Evidence-Based Service Design' and 'Cross-Agency Information Sharing' and determine how we should source them.
expected_behavior: Breaks down each capability gap across the five capability dimensions (People, Process, Information, Technology, Policy/Governance)
Classifies disposition as Strengthen Existing, Create Net-New, Leverage Shared/Cross-Ministry, or Obtain Externally
Flags where capabilities have no supporting ideas or active work items

query: Review our draft capability list: '1. SharePoint Team, 2. PowerBI Dashboards, 3. Intake Triage'. Fix any naming anti-patterns.
expected_behavior: Identifies 'SharePoint Team' (org unit/tool) and 'PowerBI Dashboards' (software tool) as capability naming anti-patterns
Rewrites them into stable noun-phrase business capabilities
Populates the Capability Map & Gap Assessment template
